messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@ionwave.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@ionwave.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Security acceptance checklist — next evidence & timing (post-demo)

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today — good conversation and helpful context on IonWave's goals and constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum on the security/compliance track so procurement can move forward: 

Key pain points you raised:
- Audit log retention and ease of retrieval for transactional events (7+ years for some products)
- Fed/State data residency requirements for specific product lines
- DPA liability carve-outs and termination data deletion semantics
- Proof of controls (SOC 2 Type II) and a recent penetration test report

What Redwood can provide (initial artifacts):
- redwood_evidence_index_v1.xlsx (breaks down where artifacts map to DDQ items and retention controls)
- Sample DPA with our standard retention and deletion language (sample-dpa-redwood.docx)
- Our SOC 2 Type II cover letter and scope summary (we'll surface the report via secure link/attestation)
- Proposed pen-test scope and preferred windows (pen_test_scope-proposed.pdf)

As next steps I propose:
1) You share the IonWave DDQ and any specific retention matrix; we can map artifacts to each line item (we can do a shared workbook).
2) Redwood to deliver the evidence index and annotate which items require either 3rd-party artifacts (SOC2/pen test) or technical artifacts (logs, KMS configs).
3) Align on DPA redlines — Marissa (cc'd) will drive legal.
4) Schedule a 45-min evidence handoff call week of Jun 7 to walk through anything blocking procurement.

If that sounds ok, Samir — can you share the DDQ and confirm target timeline for procurement signature? If you prefer, we can start exchanging artifacts via the SharePoint folder (link below) — we'll generate access links with MFA required.

Secure evidence folder (proposed): https://na1.sharepoint.com/sites/redwood-ionwave/Shared%20Documents/EvidenceExchange
HubSpot deal: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/ION-2028-06

Attachments: redwood_evidence_index_v1.xlsx (attachment stub), sample-dpa-redwood.docx (attachment stub), pen_test_scope-proposed.pdf (attachment stub)

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

From: Samir Khan <samir.k@ionwave.com>

Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@ionwave.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security acceptance checklist — next evidence & timing (post-demo)

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap and for drafting the evidence index. Quick answers from our side: 

- DDQ: attached is our completed DDQ (ionwave_ddq_filled.xlsx). You'll see a few retention exceptions called out for legacy products (rows 48-54).
- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report in progress with our auditor; expected completion mid-July 2028. We can provide interim control attestations and the control matrices earlier if that helps.
- Pen test: Procurement expects a recent pen test (within 12 months) with remediation evidence. We can accept a vendor-led test by Redwood if scope matches our external-facing endpoints — please confirm scope.
- DPA: Our legal team will propose a few redlines; procurement prefers to negotiate business terms alongside security acceptance. Estimated procurement signature target: end of July (depends on legal time).

We'd like to set the evidence call on Jun 8 or Jun 9 (PST), 45 minutes. Also: our security contact (listed on the DDQ) is Priya — she'll be handling validation.

Attachments: ionwave_ddq_filled.xlsx (attachment stub)

Best,
Samir Khan
Head of Product Ops | IonWave Financial
samir.k@ionwave.com

Samir — really helpful, thanks and appreciate the DDQ. Quick responses inline and a proposed deliverable schedule below.

- SOC 2: Interim control matrices will be sufficient for now; once the Type II report is available we'll provide the redacted report via the secure folder.
- Pen test scope: see attached pen_test_scope-proposed.pdf; this covers external APIs, auth flows, and web console. If IonWave needs coverage of additional internal endpoints we can add them to scope — let us know. Final test schedule will be coordinated with your security team.
- Retention mapping: we'll annotate the ionwave_ddq_filled.xlsx and return the annotated workbook by Thu 6/6. Our evidence index will show artifacts that are "attestation-only" vs. "technical pull".
- DPA: Marissa, can you take the sample-dpa-redwood.docx and flag any terms you expect IonWave to push back on? Prefer to get that carve-out list before legal exchange.

Proposed timeline (short-cycle):
- Thu 6/6: Redwood returns annotated DDQ + evidence index (redwood_evidence_index_v1_annotated.xlsx)
- Fri 6/7: 45-min handoff call (evidence deep-dive) — propose 10:00 AM PST
- Week of Jul 16: SOC 2 Type II expected (ext depends on auditor)
- End of Jul: target procurement signature (per Samir)

Irene/Marissa — I'll rely on you both to own the artifact delivery and DPA redline prep.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the handoff call.

Rishi

Rishi / Samir — thanks for the plan. Jun 7 at 10:00 AM PST works for our security validation call. A couple of notes from procurement/security: 

- We will require proof of immutable audit logs for the first 2 weeks of the retention period during the handoff call. Please be prepared to demo log retrieval and a sample export.
- For DPA, we'll propose a standard indemnity cap tied to recurring spend; legal will send redlines after the call.
- Pen test: our vendor requires that the test window be no earlier than Aug 1 to allow our teams to coordinate external dependency testing. If Redwood needs earlier, we can discuss scope split.

I'll be on the call and will bring one of our infra engineers (Ben) for the log demo.

Thanks,
